title: Axolotl Totem of Undying
description: This project adds totems that look like blue axolotls!
body:
This texture pack adds blue axolotl totems to Minecraft! They still have their angel wings though! (This is an overlay.) Join my discord: https://discord.gg/VYY4b5pzUN

![Totem in hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9243b18e5131c009c70ec570213f1f23136eea8.jpeg)

Have fun with the totems! \(＾▽＾)/
